note: Refreshed on the 1st of each month. Past events still hide daily in the browser. Dutch Bros, Starbucks Denton, and Higher Grounds prices kept — no public Denton-area menu confirmed.

events.title: Blocktober Party & Pumpkin Drop
events.desc: Denton Halloween kickoff at Quakertown Civic Center. Food trucks, bounce houses, and the pumpkin drop. Same-day crowd on the Denton side.

events.title: State Fair of Texas
events.desc: Fair Park, Dallas. Gates open at 10 AM. Regional weekend traffic through the 18th — not a Ponder stop, but families are out.

events.title: Denton Community Market
events.desc: 317 W Mulberry, Denton. Producer market with food vendors and live music through Dec 20. Yoga at 9:30 behind the Quaker House.

events.title: Denton County Farmers Market
events.desc: Historical Park parking lot, Carroll and Mulberry. County permit runs Saturdays through Nov 28. Produce and makers, overlapping the Community Market.

events.title: Lions vs Lake Worth (HOME)
events.desc: First district home game at Ponder ISD Stadium. Pre-game window for coffee, cocoa, and cinnamon rolls.

events.title: Hallo-Wing at Denton Enterprise Airport
events.desc: City Halloween event at Denton Enterprise Airport. Trick-or-treat at aircraft, food trucks, and an outdoor movie. Saturday crowd the day after the home game.

events.title: Denton Day of the Dead Festival
events.desc: Downtown Denton, Hickory and Industrial. Street festival Saturday 11 AM–9 PM with coffin races, vendors, and Cirque du Horror. Biggest Denton weekend of the month.

events.title: Lions vs Krum (HOME)
events.desc: Last scheduled home game. District matchup with Krum. Friday is already a student day off under the 4-day week.

2026 sheet: free shipping on 40 lb+. October flavor list includes pumpkin spice and candy corn. The spring 10% new-account special is not on the sheet and is dropped.
Syrups, sauces, cups, and equipment at wholesale pricing. Same-day shipping was not on the current homepage — call (866) 570-0498 to confirm.
Green-coffee importer. Standing full-pallet discount: $300 off eligible 10/20/30-bag pallets. The 12% cafe subscription was not listed and is dropped.
Turn-key wholesale programs since 1985, no licensing fee listed. Current page points to an inquiry form rather than a free consultation offer.
Craft wholesale roaster for cafes and foodservice. The 20% first-order discount and free sample kit were not on the wholesale page and are dropped.

socialTrends.name: Yam spice latte
socialTrends.desc: Sweet-potato spice is on cafe boards this month, including West Oak’s Yam Spice Latte at $5.95.
socialTrends.ponderSpin: Roast the yam in the same oven as the cinnamon rolls and call it a Ponder yam roll latte.

socialTrends.name: Pumpkin brûlée
socialTrends.desc: Torch-top pumpkin drinks are the fall photo, not just pumpkin-spice syrup.
socialTrends.ponderSpin: Brûlée a spoon of brown sugar on the foam. You already have the cinnamon-roll sugar.

socialTrends.name: Maple pecan cold foam
socialTrends.desc: Maple foam on cold brew or chai still photographs well and is not pumpkin-only.
socialTrends.ponderSpin: Toast Texas pecans so the truck smells like the drink. Sell it next to the roll.

socialTrends.name: Apple cider espresso
socialTrends.desc: Hot cider with a shot, or cider steamed into a latte. Simple and seasonal.
socialTrends.ponderSpin: Friday-night size: a small cider americano for the bleachers, not a 20 oz science project.

socialTrends.name: Football cocoa
socialTrends.desc: Hot chocolate with a shot, or Mexican cocoa with cinnamon, is the cold-front order.
socialTrends.ponderSpin: Chalk it as Lions cocoa on Lake Worth night (Oct 16) and Krum night (Nov 6).

spring.name: Lavender Honey Latte
spring.desc: Espresso with local honey, steamed milk and a touch of lavender syrup. Light and floral.
spring.tip: Top with dried lavender buds for a pretty presentation.

spring.name: Texas Pecan Cold Brew
spring.desc: Slow-steeped cold brew with house-made pecan syrup and a splash of oat milk.
spring.tip: Use locally sourced pecans for that real Texas flavor.

spring.name: Strawberry Matcha Lemonade
spring.desc: Iced matcha layered over fresh strawberry puree and sparkling lemonade.

spring.name: Cinnamon Roll Latte
spring.desc: Inspired by your famous scratch-made cinnamon rolls — cinnamon, brown sugar, cream cheese foam.
spring.tip: Pair with an actual cinnamon roll for the ultimate combo deal.

spring.name: Honey Bee Flat White
spring.desc: Velvety flat white sweetened with raw local honey and a light dusting of cinnamon.
spring.tip: Source honey from Denton County beekeepers for a hyper-local story.

spring.name: Mint Mocha Iced
spring.desc: Rich chocolate mocha poured over ice with fresh mint and whipped cream.
spring.tip: Muddle real mint leaves for a garden-fresh twist.

summer.name: Watermelon Agua Fresca Coffee
summer.desc: Cold brew meets fresh watermelon agua fresca — surprisingly refreshing.
summer.tip: Perfect for 100+ degree days. Serve in Mason jars.

summer.name: Coconut Vanilla Cold Brew
summer.desc: Smooth cold brew, coconut cream and Madagascar vanilla over crushed ice.
summer.tip: Freeze coconut milk into cubes so it never gets watered down.

summer.name: Peach Sweet Tea Espresso
summer.desc: A true Texas fusion — sweet peach tea with a shot of espresso over ice.
summer.tip: Use Hill Country peaches when in season.

summer.name: Mexican Horchata Latte
summer.desc: Creamy cinnamon-rice milk horchata mixed with espresso. Sweet and spiced.
summer.tip: Batch the horchata base daily for consistent creaminess.

summer.name: Frozen Caramel Macchiato
summer.desc: Blended espresso with caramel, vanilla and milk — frozen to perfection.
summer.tip: Drizzle caramel inside the cup for a beautiful spiral effect.

summer.name: Blueberry Lemon Cold Brew
summer.desc: Bright blueberry compote and lemon zest stirred into nitrogen cold brew.
summer.tip: Garnish with a lemon wheel and a few fresh berries.

fall.name: Ponder Yam Roll Latte
fall.desc: Roasted sweet potato, brown sugar, and cinnamon with espresso and steamed milk. Same spice note as the rolls.
fall.tip: West Oak is at $5.95 for a yam spice latte. Yours should come with a roll upsell.

fall.name: Pumpkin Brûlée Latte
fall.desc: Real pumpkin puree, warm spices, espresso, and a torched brown-sugar cap. Not syrup-only.
fall.tip: A pinch of cayenne is the Texas version. Torch only if the line is short.

fall.name: Maple Pecan Cold Foam
fall.desc: Cold brew or chai with maple foam and toasted Texas pecans.
fall.tip: Toast the pecans in the morning so the truck smells like the drink.

fall.name: Apple Cider Americano
fall.desc: Hot cider cut with a double shot. Small, fast, and bleacher-friendly.
fall.tip: Batch the cider. Shot it to order so it does not sit and thin out.

fall.name: Lions Cocoa
fall.desc: Mexican hot chocolate with cinnamon, optional espresso shot, whipped cream.
fall.tip: Chalk it for Lake Worth (Oct 16) and Krum (Nov 6). Offer a kids size without the shot.

fall.name: Brown Sugar Oat Shaker
fall.desc: Shaken espresso, brown-sugar syrup, oat milk. Still the iced order on warm October afternoons.
fall.tip: Use the same brown sugar as the cinnamon-roll filling so the menu rhymes.

winter.name: Gingerbread Latte
winter.desc: Warm ginger, molasses and cinnamon espresso with whipped cream and cookie crumbs.
winter.tip: Serve with a mini gingerbread man perched on the rim.

winter.name: Peppermint White Mocha
winter.desc: White chocolate mocha with real peppermint and crushed candy cane topping.
winter.tip: Use white chocolate shavings on top for an elegant touch.

winter.name: Mexican Hot Chocolate
winter.desc: Rich dark chocolate, cinnamon, a hint of chili and topped with whipped cream.

winter.name: Eggnog Espresso
winter.desc: Creamy eggnog steamed with espresso and a dusting of fresh nutmeg.
winter.tip: Offer a dairy-free version with oat-based nog.

winter.name: Cranberry Orange Americano
winter.desc: Bright cranberry syrup and orange zest over a classic hot Americano.
winter.tip: Garnish with a dehydrated orange wheel — gorgeous and shelf-stable.

winter.name: Fireside S’mores Mocha
winter.desc: Chocolate mocha with graham cracker crumbs and toasted marshmallow cream.
winter.tip: Toast the marshmallow with a torch tableside for a fun experience.
